programmes.d: Falling approval ratings and a sagging economy, cause a desperate U.S. president to turn America against its most unlikely enemy, Canada. A Niagara Falls sheriff and his band of misfit deputies invade Canada leaving the President's plans in shambles.

Woody Allen's humor is at his wild and bizarre best in this story of a "weird-gadget" tester who, after being jilted by his girlfriend (Louise Lasser), ends up as president of a tiny country where absurdity reigns.

In this delightful romantic comedy, when his candidate loses the U.S. presidential election, a fervent liberal (Breckin Meyer) makes good on his promise to move to Canada and meets a sexy and mysterious young woman (Anna Paquin) along the way.
